body: Commission on the Status of Women
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN
  City Hall, Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to the meeting of the Glendale Commission on the Status of Women. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and
rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s
Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at www.ci.glendale.ca.us/video_archives.asp. PLEASE TURN OFF
MOBILE PHONES AND PAGERS WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBER.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to items on this agenda that are received
less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Management Services Department, 613 E.
Broadway, Suite 200, Glendale, CA 91206. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the
Management Services Department at (818) 548-4844 during regular business hours.

  August 12, 2019, 5:30 pm

  1. ROLL CALL
  A. Flag Salute: Chair Lynda Burns
  B. Report regarding the posting of the Agenda: The Agenda for the August 12, 2019 meeting
  was posted on the bulletin board outside of City Hall on or before August 9, 2019.

  2. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  A. Presentation: Glendale Police Department, Det. Minas Tsolakyan

  3. ORAL COMMENT: Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of this agenda. Each speaker
  is allowed 5 minutes. The Commission may question or respond to the speaker but there will
  be no debate or discussion. Staff may refer the matter to the proper department for
  investigation and report.

  4. CONSENT ITEMS
  A. Approval of the minutes of the Regular Commission Meeting held on May 13, 2019

  5. BUSINESS AGENDA
  A. Action Items
  1. Selection of Commission Officers
  a) Motion to Select Chair for the Term of August 2019 to August 2020
  b) Motion to Select Vice Chair for the Term of August 2019 to August 2020
  2. Domestic Violence Awareness Month Activities
  a) Motion Approving Request to the Glendale City Council for Proclamation of
  October 2019 as Domestic Violence Awareness Month
  b) Motion Approving Partnership with the Glendale YWCA for the DVAM
  Candlelight Vigil and Purple Tie Awards
  3. Appointment of Selection Committee for the 2019-20 Student Ex Officio Members
  a) Motion Appointing Two Commissioners and One Student Ex Officio to the
  Selection Committee

  The Regular Meeting for Monday, November 11, 2019 is canceled due to the Veteran’s Day Holiday
  A Special Meeting will be held on Thursday, November 7, 2019 at 5:30 pm
  Council Chambers, City Hall, 613 E. Broadway, Glendale
   4. Update Regarding Ad Hoc Committees to Support the 2019-22 Strategic Plan for the
  Commission on the Status of Women
  a) Motion Providing Further Direction on Ad Hoc Committees
B. Reports – Information Only
  1. Update on the Commission on the Status of Women’s Legislative Agenda
  2. Program Update for the 19th Amendment Centennial Celebration (Oral Report)

6. COMMISSIONER/STAFF COMMENTS

7. ADJOURNMENT

  The Regular Meeting for Monday, November 11, 2019 is canceled due to the Veteran’s Day Holiday
  A Special Meeting will be held on Thursday, November 7, 2019 at 5:30 pm
  Council Chambers, City Hall, 613 E. Broadway, Glendale
